deployment_status_history.reason: HOLD at RESEARCH, per explicit human decision 2026-08-04. Although the official frozen acceptance framework produced PASS (base EXP-016 + recent-period EXP-017, both PASS, no conflict), the supplementary post-COVID robustness run (EXP-018, additional evidence only, does not alter the Research Verdict) produced REJECT on a high-quality 224-trade sample (evidence quality HIGH, 90.0/100) -- negative out-of-sample expectancy specifically in the most recent structural regime. The strategy also underperformed the existing paper-trading strategy 52-Week High Momentum (SW-003) on every primary performance metric (CAGR, Sharpe, MaxDD, profit factor, win rate, expectancy, at both the base and recent-period horizon). The diversification comparison (genuine sector-exposure divergence from SW-003, see swing_research/strategy_library/cross_sectional_momentum.md) is preserved as real evidence but is judged insufficient on its own to justify paper trading at this stage. May be reconsidered later if additional published strategies (e.g. PEAD) demonstrate complementary behavior that changes the overall portfolio decision. Research Verdict (PASS) is unaffected by this Deployment Status decision -- the two remain fully independent.

Promoted 2026-08-17 as a deliberate forward-evidence decision, per explicit direction: paper trading is a forward-evidence stage, not a reward for a perfect historical record. Research Verdict remains PASS, unchanged (base EXP-016 + recent-period EXP-017, both PASS, no conflict) -- this promotion does not alter it. The prior HOLD-at-RESEARCH reasoning (a REJECT on the supplementary post-COVID robustness run EXP-018, and underperformance vs SW-003 on every primary metric) is preserved in this record's own history below, not overwritten -- that evidence is real and unresolved by this promotion. The temporal regime diagnostics run 2026-08-17 (EXP-036..EXP-040) found the EXP-018 weakness sensitive to walk-forward window construction rather than cleanly confirmed as a stable structural regime effect, and further historical slicing was explicitly ruled out as unproductive. Rather than continue slicing historical data indefinitely, SW-006 joins SW-002/003/007/008 in PAPER_TRADING to gather real forward market evidence directly.

DEFERRED -- historical earnings surprise dataset unavailable, per explicit decision 2026-08-05. PEAD (Bernard and Thomas 1989/1990; Foster, Olsen and Shevlin 1984) requires Standardized Unexpected Earnings (SUE) computed from ~8-10 years of quarterly earnings-surprise events per symbol across the 457-symbol frozen universe, to support the standard 2-year validation + 10-year evaluation + recent-period + post-COVID robustness pipeline used for every other strategy. Investigated: (1) fundamentals/fundamental_agent.py -- point-in-time-only snapshot (trailing P/E, ROE, debt/equity), no earnings-surprise or historical time-series capability. (2) yfinance (the only data source integrated anywhere in this program) -- live-tested against real NSE symbols (RELIANCE.NS, TCS.NS): Ticker.earnings_history returns the right FIELDS (epsActual, epsEstimate, epsDifference, surprisePercent) but only ~4 trailing quarters (~1 year); quarterly_income_stmt/quarterly_financials EPS rows are similarly capped at ~5 quarters; Ticker.calendar is forward-looking only (next unannounced earnings date). No analyst-consensus-estimate history exists via any available source. (3) No cached or alternative earnings/fundamentals dataset exists anywhere in this repository. CONCLUSION: faithful implementation is not currently possible -- not a disclosed-assumption situation like every other strategys NSE adaptations, but a hard data-availability ceiling (~1 year available vs ~8-10 years required). Per explicit direction: do not implement using incomplete data, do not reduce the evaluation period, do not substitute a different signal, do not create an approximation that changes the published strategy. No backtest was run; no Research Verdict applies (remains NOT_YET_EVALUATED). REVISIT CONDITION: if a historical earnings/analyst-consensus dataset covering the Nifty 500 for approximately 10 years becomes available (e.g. a paid data vendor, or a dataset the user sources independently), PEAD can be reconsidered under the same frozen research protocol used for every other strategy.

Promoted 2026-08-17 as a FORWARD EVIDENCE EXPERIMENT, explicitly distinguished from a historically-validated strategy. Research Verdict remains NOT_YET_EVALUATED, unchanged -- no historical backtest exists or is claimed. Reliable historical earnings-event data remains insufficient for a proper multi-year backtest (unchanged conclusion from the 2026-08-05 deferral). However, a NEW forward-only data source (yfinance get_earnings_dates(), live-verified 2026-08-17 to provide ~24 quarters of actual EPS going forward, sufficient for a faithful seasonal-random-walk SUE calculation per Foster/Olsen/Shevlin 1984) makes FORWARD real-market evidence collection viable starting now. Deployment via deployment/pead_forward_engine.py -- event-driven detection, documented SUE rules (swing_research/published_research_analyst.py POST_EARNINGS_ANNOUNCEMENT_DRIFT record), full candidate-event logging (not only trades taken), conservative lookahead-avoidant entry timing. Purpose: accumulate real observations to eventually answer whether the PEAD effect appears in the Indian market under these exact rules -- not to validate or invalidate the historical question this deferral already identified as unanswerable with available data.
